Klasse Task<A>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Task<A>
Typparameter:
A - the type of the computed value
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Appliable<Task.µ,A>, Bindable<Task.µ,A>, Mappable<Task.µ,A>, Monadic<Task.µ,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Task.µ,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Task.µ>
public final class Task<A> extends Object implements Monadic<Task.µ,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Task.µ,A>

A computation description that encapsulates an asynchronous evaluation yielding a Result.

Task implements Monadic and Higher1, allowing functional and monadic transformations such as map(Function), applyTo(Higher1), and flatMap(Function). Computations are evaluated lazily and only executed when runAsync(Executor) or runAsync() is invoked.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • taskFrom

      public static <A> Task<A> taskFrom(@NonNull Supplier<A> supplier)

      Creates a new Task that evaluates the specified Supplier asynchronously when run, yielding the computed value wrapped in a Result.

      Any exception thrown during evaluation is captured and returned as a failed Result.

      Typparameter:
      A - the type of the computed value
      Parameter:
      supplier - the supplier producing the value; must not be null and must not return null
      Gibt zurück:

      public <B,C> Task<C> zip(@NonNull Task<B> other, @NonNull BiFunction<? super A, ? super B, ? extends C> combiner)

      Combines this Task with another Task using the given combiner function.

      @UnwindingOperation public CompletableFuture<Result<A>> runAsync(@NonNull Executor executor)

      Asynchronously executes this task using the specified executor.

      Any exception thrown during the execution is captured and wrapped into a failed Result. Errors (instances of Error) are rethrown.

      Parameter:
